description: Defines the IValue class and related structures for representing TorchScript interpreter values, including various types, constructors, and utility functions.

classes.name: IValue
classes.description: A tagged union class representing all value types used by TorchScript, with various constructors, type checks, and conversion methods.

classes.name: WeakIValue
classes.description: A non-owning weak reference to an IValue, supporting lock and identity checks.

classes.name: StrongTypePtr
classes.description: An owning pointer to a type, including a shared pointer to a CompilationUnit and a TypePtr.

classes.name: WeakTypePtr
classes.description: A non-owning weak pointer to a type, including a weak pointer to a CompilationUnit and a TypePtr.

classes.name: WeakOrStrongCompilationUnit
classes.description: A wrapper that holds either a shared or weak pointer to a CompilationUnit.

classes.name: WeakOrStrongTypePtr
classes.description: A wrapper that holds either a weak or strong reference to a type and its compilation unit.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for an IValue.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if two IValues are the same object (identity).

methods.name: deepcopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an IValue, optionally with device specification.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Applies a visitor function to all subvalues of an IValue.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if two IValues share subvalues.

methods.name: getSubValues
methods.description: Inserts all subvalues of an IValue into a set.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the IValue.
